body:
- **Tailwind utilities first** — per `CLAUDE.md` §Styling. No `fv-*`
  classes except one (`fv-adr-body`) reserved for future MDX body
  typography hooks if needed.
- **shadcn tokens** for neutral color (`bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`,
  `border`).
- **Semantic colors via `TONE_CLASS`** imported from `@filemark/datagrid`
  — same idiom as status pills / tag chips / filter badges across the
  rest of the project. This is the reason semantic greens/reds/ambers
  are centralized: one edit updates every tone-using component.

---
